title: Checkout 500s when the cart is empty
body: Testing checkout on Sofia Reyes's account (sofia.reyes@example.com). POST /customers/:customerId/checkout with an empty cart returns 500 'Internal Server Error'. It reproduces every time: open a fresh cart, add nothing, post a valid test card. A 500 means the server threw rather than turned me away, and an empty cart is not a surprising thing for a customer to do, so I do not think this is meant to happen.
